g.text: 2020 Few-Shot Learning Brown et al. trained a 175B-parameter
autoregressive Transformer on 499B tokens. The key finding: simply
scaling dramatically improves few-shot performance — the model
learns new tasks from just a few examples in the prompt, without
gradient updates. Introduced the paradigm of prompting as a
programming interface for AI. 175B Parameters In-Context Learning
Zero/One/Few-Shot Brown, Mann, Ryder et al. · OpenAI
